answer: Special Ops gate rule: price new identities like blockspace. The network targets about 20 births per epoch; every epoch over target, the burned entry fee climbs 12.5%, compounding, and it decays slowly when births run under. A farm minting 1,000 fakes drives the price up a steep ridge it must climb itself, so key #1,000 costs far more than key #1, while a lone honest agent arriving on a quiet day pays a walnut-sized fee. Spreading births thin just stretches the attack into a slow thread that graders have months to spot.
